title.en: Programs and campuses at a glance
title.hi: कोर्स और कैंपस एक नज़र में

body.en:
## Programs
Two-year integrated programmes that combine TS Intermediate (MPC or BiPC) with preparation for JEE Main, JEE Advanced (IIT) or NEET-UG, plus a Long Term programme for students who have finished Class 12.

## Campuses
Girls Residential Campus at Bairamalguda, Boys Residential Campus at Kuntloor, and the Day Scholar Campus at LB Nagar, Hyderabad. Central Administration Office: Saroornagar.

## Class size
Batches have at most 40 students, with one mentor for every 20 students.
body.te:
## కోర్సులు
TS ఇంటర్మీడియట్ (MPC లేదా BiPC)తో పాటు JEE మెయిన్, JEE అడ్వాన్స్‌డ్ (IIT) లేదా NEET-UG తయారీ కలిపిన రెండు సంవత్సరాల కోర్సులు; 12వ తరగతి పూర్తి చేసిన వారికి లాంగ్ టర్మ్.

## క్యాంపస్‌లు
బాలికల రెసిడెన్షియల్ (బైరామల్‌గూడ), బాలుర రెసిడెన్షియల్ (కుంట్లూర్), డే స్కాలర్ (LB నగర్).
body.hi:
## कोर्स
TS इंटरमीडिएट (MPC या BiPC) के साथ JEE मेन, JEE एडवांस्ड (IIT) या NEET-UG की तैयारी वाले दो वर्षीय कोर्स; कक्षा 12 पूरी कर चुके छात्रों के लिए लॉन्ग टर्म।

## कैंपस
बालिका आवासीय (बैरामलगुडा), बालक आवासीय (कुंटलूर), डे स्कॉलर (LB नगर)।

body.en:
## Two-year programmes
Students who have passed Class 10 (SSC or CBSE/ICSE) and are joining Intermediate first year.

## Long Term
Students who have passed Class 12 / Intermediate and want a focused year for JEE or NEET.

The counsellor confirms the right program after the campus visit and counselling session.

title.en: Admission steps and how to track them

body.en:
Enquiry → campus visit → counselling → application → document verification → fee payment and receipt → College ID.

Parents can follow every step on the Track your admission page with a one-time code sent to the mobile number used for the enquiry. The College ID is issued only after the application, documents, fee payment, receipt and student record are complete.

The Admission Office checks the documents on the admission checklist (shown on the Admissions page and in the parent app), typically: Class 10 marks memo, transfer certificate, study certificates, Aadhaar, passport-size photos, and caste/income certificates only if a scholarship needs them.

Upload them from the parent app before the verification visit to save time.

title.en: BSAT scholarship: up to 60% off tuition
title.hi: BSAT छात्रवृत्ति: ट्यूशन पर 60% तक छूट

body.en:
One 90-minute test, the Bhargava Scholarship Admission Test (BSAT), decides a tuition scholarship of up to 60%, depending on the score band. Register on the Scholarship page; the test runs on campus or online and results come quickly.

The fee structure and a fee calculator are on the Fees page.

Before choosing a stream, parents can work through the free 10-step Parent Counselling Guide on the website (English, Telugu, Hindi) and then book a counselling session. The counsellor records the discussion so the family never has to repeat itself.

In the first week new students meet their mentor, get the timetable and study material, tour the labs and library, and take a short diagnostic test so faculty know where to start. Parents attend an orientation session on the first Saturday.
Yes. Bhargava Junior College is recognised by the Government of Telangana (TS Board of Intermediate Education), College Code 58560, and run by Sri Vihana Educational Society.

title.en: Student handbook: daily routine and conduct

body.en:
## Routine
Classes, study hours and tests follow the batch timetable in the app. Hostellers follow the hostel schedule.

## Dress code
College uniform on all working days; ID card worn on campus.

## Mobile phones
Phones are not used in classrooms or study hours. Hostellers deposit phones with the warden and call home at the set times.

## TS Board of Intermediate Education
Students must meet the board’s minimum attendance (75%) to be allowed to write the Intermediate public examinations; shortage is condoned only as the board allows.

## BJC rules
Weekly tests are compulsory; a missed test is written the next week. Homework and DPPs are checked by the subject teacher.
Keep attendance at 75% or above (TSBIE minimum). Parents apply for leave in the app (day scholars) or approve hostel out-passes. Absence without leave is reported to parents the same day.
body.te: హాజరు 75% లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉంచండి (TSBIE కనీసం). తల్లిదండ్రులు యాప్‌లో సెలవు కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేస్తారు. అనుమతి లేని గైర్హాజరు అదే రోజు తల్లిదండ్రులకు తెలియజేయబడుతుంది.
body.hi: उपस्थिति 75% या अधिक रखें (TSBIE न्यूनतम)। अभिभावक ऐप में अवकाश के लिए आवेदन करते हैं। बिना अनुमति की अनुपस्थिति की सूचना उसी दिन अभिभावकों को दी जाती है।

title.en: Recounting, re-verification and Advanced Supplementary exams

body.en:
## After the results
TSBIE opens recounting and re-verification (with a photocopy of the answer script) for a few days after the results. Apply online with the fee; the college office helps.

## Advanced Supplementary
Students who fail or want to improve can write the Advanced Supplementary Examinations held soon after the results (usually May–June). Dates come in the TSBIE press note.

BSAT gives a tuition scholarship of up to 60% at admission. Eligible students can also apply for Telangana post-matric scholarships through the ePASS portal; the office checks the documents and deadlines with you.

title.en: After Inter: JoSAA, NEET and EAPCET counselling

body.en:
## Engineering
JEE Main ranks lead to NITs, IIITs and GFTIs; JEE Advanced ranks lead to IITs. Seats are allotted through JoSAA counselling (registration, choice filling, rounds).

## Medical
NEET-UG: 15% All India Quota through MCC counselling; state quota seats in Telangana through the state counselling (KNRUHS).

## State
TS EAPCET ranks for state engineering and agriculture/pharmacy colleges.
Daily Practice Problems (DPPs) are given after each topic. Submit homework in the app before the due time; late work is marked late. Ask doubts in the app or at the doubt desk.

title.en: Practical record rules (Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology)

body.en: Write each experiment in the record the same week, with aim, apparatus, observations and result. Records are signed by the lecturer and are needed for the board practical examination.
An on-campus counsellor is available; book a private session in the app. Monthly check-ins help mentors notice stress early. What you tell the counsellor stays private.

title.en: Choosing between engineering, medicine and other paths

body.en: Talk to your mentor about strengths, mock-test trends and interests. Besides IIT/NIT and medicine, consider pure sciences (IISER/NISER), architecture, pharmacy, agriculture and law entrance routes.

You get a weekly WhatsApp report every Sunday. In the app: attendance, results, fees and receipts, PTM booking, messages to the class teacher, out-pass approvals and the hostel menu. One mentor looks after every 20 students with a weekly one-to-one.

In an emergency call the college office numbers on the Contact page; they reach the warden and security of each campus. Warden, security and doctor numbers per campus will be listed here by the office.
PTM slots open in the app before each PTM day. Book a 10-minute slot with the class teacher; you can also message the teacher any time.
Fees can be paid in instalments. Reminders go out 3 days before a due date and while an instalment is overdue. Receipts are always in the app.
Board hall tickets come through the college. Check name, photo, subjects and centre. Carry it with your college ID to every paper; keep a photocopy at home.
No phones, smart watches, notes or calculators (unless allowed). Arrive 30 minutes early. Any malpractice in a board exam is reported to TSBIE and can cancel the result.
Weekly tests follow the syllabus plan; grand and mock tests follow the JEE/NEET pattern. Results, rank and chapter-wise analysis appear in the app.
The office helps you register for JEE Main (NTA), JEE Advanced and NEET-UG: photo and signature specs, category certificates and fee payment. Check your details twice before submitting.

title.en: IITs, NITs, IIITs and AIIMS: what to know

body.en: There are 23 IITs (JEE Advanced) and 31 NITs plus IIITs and GFTIs (JEE Main, through JoSAA). AIIMS and government medical colleges admit through NEET-UG counselling. Cut-offs change every year; use the latest JoSAA/MCC opening and closing ranks.

title.en: JoSAA and MCC choice filling: a checklist

body.en: Register, list choices from most to least preferred, lock before the deadline, and keep documents ready for verification: Class 10 and 12 memos, rank card, category and income certificates, photos and ID.
After every mock: list wrong and skipped questions by chapter, redo them within 48 hours, and track time per section. Weak chapters appear in your analytics.
Each year students show science projects and talents to parents and guests. Departments guide the projects; prizes go to the best models in each stream.
Students take part in national olympiads and inter-college quizzes. The departments coach selected students after class.
Students join tree planting, blood-donation awareness and community clean-up drives organised by the college (NSS is not applicable at junior college level).
Books are lent for 14 days. Return or renew on time; late books are marked overdue and the librarian reminds you.
NCERT books, previous papers and recorded classes are linked in the app under Study. Ask the librarian for anything not listed.
Teaching hours, lesson plans, attendance marking in the app at the start of each period, homework and DPP checking, doubt desk duty and mentor one-to-ones.
Apply for leave in the CRM at least two days ahead (except emergencies). Arrange a substitute for your periods; the Principal approves.
Collect papers from the exam cell 15 minutes before; check IDs; no phones in the hall; report any malpractice to the chief superintendent in writing.
Enter marks in the CRM within 48 hours of a test. Use the chapter tags so analytics are correct. Publish only after a second check.
Reviews each term combine results trends, syllabus completion, student feedback and observation. Individual reviews are private to the faculty member, Principal and Management.

title.en: Emergency procedures: fire, medical, missing student

body.en:
## Fire
Raise the alarm, evacuate by the marked routes, assemble at the ground, take the register count, call 101.

## Medical
First aid at the sick room, call the doctor, inform parents, ambulance 108 if needed.

## Missing student
Inform the warden and principal at once, check the gate log and CCTV, call the parents, inform the police if not found within the hour.
Salary statements are prepared by Accounts by the 25th and approved by Management. Only Accounts and Admin handle payroll documents.
All visitors sign in at the front desk and get a pass; students leave only with an approved out-pass; CCTV covers gates and corridors.
Recognised by the Government of Telangana, College Code 58560. Affiliation renewal papers, inspection reports and board correspondence are filed here.

body.en: Families give consent in the app before records are shown. Only staff who need a record can see it; phone numbers are masked for others. Deletion requests are handled by the office and recorded here.
Degree certificates and experience letters for every lecturer, kept for board inspections.

title.en: Programs and campuses at a glance
title.hi: कोर्स और कैंपस एक नज़र में

body.en:
## Programs
Two-year integrated programmes that combine TS Intermediate (MPC or BiPC) with preparation for JEE Main, JEE Advanced (IIT) or NEET-UG, plus a Long Term programme for students who have finished Class 12.

## Campuses
Girls Residential Campus at Bairamalguda, Boys Residential Campus at Kuntloor, and the Day Scholar Campus at LB Nagar, Hyderabad. Central Administration Office: Saroornagar.

## Class size
Batches have at most 40 students, with one mentor for every 20 students.
body.te:
## కోర్సులు
TS ఇంటర్మీడియట్ (MPC లేదా BiPC)తో పాటు JEE మెయిన్, JEE అడ్వాన్స్‌డ్ (IIT) లేదా NEET-UG తయారీ కలిపిన రెండు సంవత్సరాల కోర్సులు; 12వ తరగతి పూర్తి చేసిన వారికి లాంగ్ టర్మ్.

## క్యాంపస్‌లు
బాలికల రెసిడెన్షియల్ (బైరామల్‌గూడ), బాలుర రెసిడెన్షియల్ (కుంట్లూర్), డే స్కాలర్ (LB నగర్).
body.hi:
## कोर्स
TS इंटरमीडिएट (MPC या BiPC) के साथ JEE मेन, JEE एडवांस्ड (IIT) या NEET-UG की तैयारी वाले दो वर्षीय कोर्स; कक्षा 12 पूरी कर चुके छात्रों के लिए लॉन्ग टर्म।

## कैंपस
बालिका आवासीय (बैरामलगुडा), बालक आवासीय (कुंटलूर), डे स्कॉलर (LB नगर)।

body.en:
## Two-year programmes
Students who have passed Class 10 (SSC or CBSE/ICSE) and are joining Intermediate first year.

## Long Term
Students who have passed Class 12 / Intermediate and want a focused year for JEE or NEET.

The counsellor confirms the right program after the campus visit and counselling session.

title.en: Admission steps and how to track them

body.en:
Enquiry → campus visit → counselling → application → document verification → fee payment and receipt → College ID.

Parents can follow every step on the Track your admission page with a one-time code sent to the mobile number used for the enquiry. The College ID is issued only after the application, documents, fee payment, receipt and student record are complete.

The Admission Office checks the documents on the admission checklist (shown on the Admissions page and in the parent app), typically: Class 10 marks memo, transfer certificate, study certificates, Aadhaar, passport-size photos, and caste/income certificates only if a scholarship needs them.

Upload them from the parent app before the verification visit to save time.

title.en: BSAT scholarship: up to 60% off tuition
title.hi: BSAT छात्रवृत्ति: ट्यूशन पर 60% तक छूट

body.en:
One 90-minute test, the Bhargava Scholarship Admission Test (BSAT), decides a tuition scholarship of up to 60%, depending on the score band. Register on the Scholarship page; the test runs on campus or online and results come quickly.

The fee structure and a fee calculator are on the Fees page.

Before choosing a stream, parents can work through the free 10-step Parent Counselling Guide on the website (English, Telugu, Hindi) and then book a counselling session. The counsellor records the discussion so the family never has to repeat itself.

In the first week new students meet their mentor, get the timetable and study material, tour the labs and library, and take a short diagnostic test so faculty know where to start. Parents attend an orientation session on the first Saturday.
Yes. Bhargava Junior College is recognised by the Government of Telangana (TS Board of Intermediate Education), College Code 58560, and run by Sri Vihana Educational Society.

title.en: How will I know how my child is doing?

body.en: Every Sunday parents get a WhatsApp report with attendance, the test trend and the mentor’s note. In the parent app you can see attendance, results and fees, book a PTM and message the class teacher.

Fee structure for the 2024-25 academic year. Tuition, study material and hostel fees for 2024-25 are listed on the fee card.

(Old: kept to show outdated-content detection. The current fees are on the Fees page.)

title.en: Student handbook: daily routine and conduct

body.en:
## Routine
Classes, study hours and tests follow the batch timetable in the app. Hostellers follow the hostel schedule.

## Dress code
College uniform on all working days; ID card worn on campus.

## Mobile phones
Phones are not used in classrooms or study hours. Hostellers deposit phones with the warden and call home at the set times.

## TS Board of Intermediate Education
Students must meet the board’s minimum attendance (75%) to be allowed to write the Intermediate public examinations; shortage is condoned only as the board allows.

## BJC rules
Weekly tests are compulsory; a missed test is written the next week. Homework and DPPs are checked by the subject teacher.
Keep attendance at 75% or above (TSBIE minimum). Parents apply for leave in the app (day scholars) or approve hostel out-passes. Absence without leave is reported to parents the same day.
body.te: హాజరు 75% లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉంచండి (TSBIE కనీసం). తల్లిదండ్రులు యాప్‌లో సెలవు కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేస్తారు. అనుమతి లేని గైర్హాజరు అదే రోజు తల్లిదండ్రులకు తెలియజేయబడుతుంది.
body.hi: उपस्थिति 75% या अधिक रखें (TSBIE न्यूनतम)। अभिभावक ऐप में अवकाश के लिए आवेदन करते हैं। बिना अनुमति की अनुपस्थिति की सूचना उसी दिन अभिभावकों को दी जाती है।

title.en: Recounting, re-verification and Advanced Supplementary exams

body.en:
## After the results
TSBIE opens recounting and re-verification (with a photocopy of the answer script) for a few days after the results. Apply online with the fee; the college office helps.

## Advanced Supplementary
Students who fail or want to improve can write the Advanced Supplementary Examinations held soon after the results (usually May–June). Dates come in the TSBIE press note.

BSAT gives a tuition scholarship of up to 60% at admission. Eligible students can also apply for Telangana post-matric scholarships through the ePASS portal; the office checks the documents and deadlines with you.

title.en: After Inter: JoSAA, NEET and EAPCET counselling

body.en:
## Engineering
JEE Main ranks lead to NITs, IIITs and GFTIs; JEE Advanced ranks lead to IITs. Seats are allotted through JoSAA counselling (registration, choice filling, rounds).

## Medical
NEET-UG: 15% All India Quota through MCC counselling; state quota seats in Telangana through the state counselling (KNRUHS).

## State
TS EAPCET ranks for state engineering and agriculture/pharmacy colleges.
Daily Practice Problems (DPPs) are given after each topic. Submit homework in the app before the due time; late work is marked late. Ask doubts in the app or at the doubt desk.

title.en: Practical record rules (Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology)

body.en: Write each experiment in the record the same week, with aim, apparatus, observations and result. Records are signed by the lecturer and are needed for the board practical examination.
An on-campus counsellor is available; book a private session in the app. Monthly check-ins help mentors notice stress early. What you tell the counsellor stays private.

title.en: Choosing between engineering, medicine and other paths

body.en: Talk to your mentor about strengths, mock-test trends and interests. Besides IIT/NIT and medicine, consider pure sciences (IISER/NISER), architecture, pharmacy, agriculture and law entrance routes.

You get a weekly WhatsApp report every Sunday. In the app: attendance, results, fees and receipts, PTM booking, messages to the class teacher, out-pass approvals and the hostel menu. One mentor looks after every 20 students with a weekly one-to-one.

In an emergency call the college office numbers on the Contact page; they reach the warden and security of each campus. Warden, security and doctor numbers per campus will be listed here by the office.
PTM slots open in the app before each PTM day. Book a 10-minute slot with the class teacher; you can also message the teacher any time.
Fees can be paid in instalments. Reminders go out 3 days before a due date and while an instalment is overdue. Receipts are always in the app.
Board hall tickets come through the college. Check name, photo, subjects and centre. Carry it with your college ID to every paper; keep a photocopy at home.
No phones, smart watches, notes or calculators (unless allowed). Arrive 30 minutes early. Any malpractice in a board exam is reported to TSBIE and can cancel the result.
Weekly tests follow the syllabus plan; grand and mock tests follow the JEE/NEET pattern. Results, rank and chapter-wise analysis appear in the app.
The office helps you register for JEE Main (NTA), JEE Advanced and NEET-UG: photo and signature specs, category certificates and fee payment. Check your details twice before submitting.

title.en: IITs, NITs, IIITs and AIIMS: what to know

body.en: There are 23 IITs (JEE Advanced) and 31 NITs plus IIITs and GFTIs (JEE Main, through JoSAA). AIIMS and government medical colleges admit through NEET-UG counselling. Cut-offs change every year; use the latest JoSAA/MCC opening and closing ranks.

title.en: JoSAA and MCC choice filling: a checklist

body.en: Register, list choices from most to least preferred, lock before the deadline, and keep documents ready for verification: Class 10 and 12 memos, rank card, category and income certificates, photos and ID.
After every mock: list wrong and skipped questions by chapter, redo them within 48 hours, and track time per section. Weak chapters appear in your analytics.
Each year students show science projects and talents to parents and guests. Departments guide the projects; prizes go to the best models in each stream.
Students take part in national olympiads and inter-college quizzes. The departments coach selected students after class.
Students join tree planting, blood-donation awareness and community clean-up drives organised by the college (NSS is not applicable at junior college level).
Books are lent for 14 days. Return or renew on time; late books are marked overdue and the librarian reminds you.
NCERT books, previous papers and recorded classes are linked in the app under Study. Ask the librarian for anything not listed.
Teaching hours, lesson plans, attendance marking in the app at the start of each period, homework and DPP checking, doubt desk duty and mentor one-to-ones.
Apply for leave in the CRM at least two days ahead (except emergencies). Arrange a substitute for your periods; the Principal approves.
Collect papers from the exam cell 15 minutes before; check IDs; no phones in the hall; report any malpractice to the chief superintendent in writing.
Enter marks in the CRM within 48 hours of a test. Use the chapter tags so analytics are correct. Publish only after a second check.
Reviews each term combine results trends, syllabus completion, student feedback and observation. Individual reviews are private to the faculty member, Principal and Management.

title.en: Emergency procedures: fire, medical, missing student

body.en:
## Fire
Raise the alarm, evacuate by the marked routes, assemble at the ground, take the register count, call 101.

## Medical
First aid at the sick room, call the doctor, inform parents, ambulance 108 if needed.

## Missing student
Inform the warden and principal at once, check the gate log and CCTV, call the parents, inform the police if not found within the hour.
Salary statements are prepared by Accounts by the 25th and approved by Management. Only Accounts and Admin handle payroll documents.
All visitors sign in at the front desk and get a pass; students leave only with an approved out-pass; CCTV covers gates and corridors.
Recognised by the Government of Telangana, College Code 58560. Affiliation renewal papers, inspection reports and board correspondence are filed here.

body.en: Families give consent in the app before records are shown. Only staff who need a record can see it; phone numbers are masked for others. Deletion requests are handled by the office and recorded here.
